fusions.name: Butcher's Block
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A falling chop that deals 20 damage, uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Even Portions
fusions.desc: A cleaving strike that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it are shared out to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and you heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Whetted Appetite
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 25% for 15 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Next Carcass
fusions.desc: Each kill restores 4 health. When you kill an enemy, your physical damage also rises by 25% for 5 seconds, once every 6 seconds.
